description: The main window's cover (cover.rs): a page of the app over the server's page. It may drag the window, ask which server is open, load it again once it is reachable, or step aside; for the server here, start it, turn reach off, copy its details, read Tailscale's state (whether there is its app to open) or open Tailscale; for a server out of reach or the server here stopped, open the welcome window or another server of the app's list. Nothing of the server's page, the runners or this computer.
